project_type: Full-stack: FastAPI backend + React (Vite) frontend, competition app for WasteChakra 2026
build_system: Backend: pip + uvicorn (no build step). Frontend: Vite 5 (npm run build). Docker: multi-stage Dockerfile in backend/ and frontend/. No monorepo tooling — each directory is independent.
test_framework: pytest + pytest-asyncio (backend, tests go in backend/tests/). No frontend tests exist. pytest.ini should set asyncio_mode=auto and testpaths=tests.
build_command: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt (backend). cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build (frontend).
verification_instructions: 1. Install backend deps: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt. 2. Start backend: uvicorn app.main:app --reload. 3. Verify /health returns 200. 4. Verify /api/nodes/ returns 401 without token. 5. Login at /api/auth/login with admin@ecofleet.in/EcoFleet@2026, get token. 6. Re-test /api/nodes/ with token — should return 200 with 25 nodes. 7. Run tests: cd backend && pytest tests/ -v. 8. Build frontend: cd frontend && npm run build — should complete without errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/app/ml/models/waste_forecast_model.joblib (pre-trained ML model, committed, do NOT regenerate). backend/ecofleet.db (SQLite runtime DB, not committed, auto-created on startup). frontend/dist/ (build output, not committed).
environment_constraints: Windows workspace at C:\Users\Mohit\OneDrive\wastechakra. All file paths must use this absolute root. The backend auto-falls back to SQLite (ecofleet.db) when PostgreSQL is unavailable — tests MUST use SQLite via DATABASE_URL env var. The ML model file app/ml/models/waste_forecast_model.joblib exists and must not be deleted or regenerated. Do NOT run docker-compose up — it would require Docker Desktop. Do not push to remote branches without user confirmation.
contribution_requirements: Match existing inline-style React pattern (no CSS modules, no Tailwind). Match async SQLAlchemy pattern in database.py (DB-first, in-memory fallback). All new Python files need 'from __future__ import annotations' at the top. Role strings in DB are 'admin', 'manager', 'driver', 'citizen' — NOT 'fleet_manager'. Auth dependency pattern: add as function parameter (not router-level dependencies=[]) so TokenData is accessible.
key_patterns: Backend routes: DB-first with try/except fallback to in-memory SAMPLE_NODES or _TRUCKS list. Security: from app.core.security import get_current_user_token, require_role, TokenData. Auth in route: add '_token: TokenData = Depends(require_role("manager", "admin"))' as function parameter. Frontend: useAuth() hook from context/AuthContext.jsx provides {user, token, isAuthenticated, isLoading, login, logout}. All React pages use inline style objects (see FleetPage.jsx/DriverPage.jsx for patterns). API calls go through frontend/src/services/api.js axios instance. The 'user' object stored in localStorage has fields: id, email, full_name, role, is_active, created_at — NOT 'name' (Navbar reads user.name but UserResponse sends full_name — must normalize to 'name' in login()).
directory_structure: wastechakra/ — root with docker-compose.yml, .github/, .env.example (to create). backend/ — FastAPI app: app/main.py (entry), app/core/ (config.py, database.py, security.py, weather.py to create), app/api/routes/ (auth, nodes, forecast, routing, fleet, analytics), app/db/models.py, app/ml/ (forecaster.py, train_model.py, models/waste_forecast_model.joblib), app/routing/cvrp_solver.py, app/data/sample_nodes.py, app/models/schemas.py, tests/ (to create). frontend/ — Vite React: src/App.jsx, src/context/AuthContext.jsx, src/services/api.js, src/components/common/ (Navbar.jsx, ProtectedRoute.jsx to create), src/pages/ (Dashboard, RouteMap, ForecastPage, FleetPage, DriverPage, AnalyticsPage, CitizenReportPage — all exist; LoginPage.jsx and UnauthorizedPage.jsx to create), public/ (robots.txt to create).
